fields.name: title
fields.description: Short saga title shown in the in-game saga log (Norwegian flavour is fine).

fields.name: description
fields.description: Saga-giver flavour text. Write it with the player; fit Classic/Forever lore. Newlines OK.

fields.name: objectives
fields.description: Step list, NOT plain strings. The saga completes when every step is true together. Each step: id (slug), type, text (Norwegian log line), optional memory. Types: go (place; memory visit latches, hold is only while standing there; zone/subzone with | alternatives, map_id, x/y 0–1, radius; Elwynn Forest=37), talk (npc and/or object, exact UnitName), item (item_id, count; memory hold by default), emote (emote SALUTE or /salute, optional npc and place), kill (npc name, count; optional group {level, size, instance} — level is EXACT for every member, size is exact roster, instance such as The Deadmines|Deadmines; the kill latches only when each addon attests from inside), sequence (within_sec 1–600 and beats: 2–6 of go/talk/emote/kill, one checkbox, clock starts on the first beat). Do not use all_of, any_of, or objectives_ordered. Example: {"id":"tharynn","type":"talk","text":"Snakk med Tharynn Bouden","npc":"Tharynn Bouden"}. Sequence: {"id":"trick","type":"sequence","text":"Klapp, så /rude innen 30s","within_sec":30,"beats":[{"id":"clap","type":"emote","text":"Klapp","emote":"APPLAUD","npc":"Brother Wilhelm"},{"id":"rude","type":"emote","text":"Frekk","emote":"RUDE","npc":"Innkeeper Farley"}]}.

fields.name: created_by
fields.description: Author BattleTag (e.g. Magnus#2231). Creates the GutSaga player if missing.

fields.name: party
fields.description: true = every eligible character can take it; false = only assigned_character_ids.

fields.name: reward
fields.description: Reward flavour line (shown in-game; not a real item grant).

fields.name: min_level
fields.description: Minimum character level. Omit for no gate.

fields.name: assigned_character_ids
fields.description: GutSaga character UUIDs from list_characters. Use when party=false.

fields.name: objectives_ordered
fields.description: Leave false. Timed order is a sequence step, not this flag.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Defaults true. false retires the saga.

fields.name: image
fields.description: Optional cover for Discord + in-game (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF, max 8 MiB). Create with a cover in one call: phase 1 pass { filename, content_type, confirm_sandbox: true }, HTTP PUT the bytes to the returned upload_url, then phase 2 call again with { file_ref }. Omit to create without a cover. After companion sync and /reload the cover shows under the description in the addon.

fields.name: saga
fields.description: Created GutSaga saga (has_image true when a cover was uploaded).
